contenders.handicapper_notes: Brings the best sectional speed figures into this modest maiden, highlighted by a strong provincial 3rd at Newcastle (SR 65) and a narrow 4th in a Taree Super Maiden (SR 64). Hit the line solidly when 7th beaten only 2.4L over 1500m at Port Macquarie a week ago. Drawn barrier 1 to save crucial ground on the Soft 7 surface under Luke Rolls carrying a featherweight 55.5kg. Canonical style code S.

Arrowfield-bred filly by The Autumn Sun representing the premier Paul Messara and Leah Gavranich stable. Did her best work late on debut over an inadequate 1280m here when 5th. Bred to relish the step up to 1500m and draws ideally in barrier 2 for leading jockey Ashley Morgan. Key improver and primary danger. Canonical style code S.

Ran a game 2nd beaten 0.8L at Mudgee over 1400m second-up from a spell. Fitter now third-up and draws low in barrier 3 with Adam Farragher booked. Carries 59.0kg topweight tax over the 1500m route on a testing Soft 7 track, but lands a very soft run on the speed. Canonical style code P.

Brings solid experience with 4 placings from 7 starts. Led up over 1600m at Tamworth in Class 1 company last start before boxing on for 5th, and previously placed 3rd at 1400m. Handles soft conditions well and has Braith Nock aboard, though barrier 10 on the wet track creates minor tactical friction. Canonical style code E.

Progressive 3-year-old gelding having his third career start. Finished 4th over 1280m here on October 19, ahead of Moongleam. Steps up to 1500m which suits his pedigree, though he will have to negotiate a midfield-to-wide run under Mikayla Weir on a Soft 7 track. Canonical style code S.

Adelaide mare from the Rodney Northam stable making third race appearance. Stuck on fairly when 4th beaten 5.5L over 1400m on soft ground at Tamworth. Reece Jones retains the ride from a favorable inside gate. Capable of filling the lower exotics. Canonical style code S.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Massive class standout following mass scratchings. Drops sharply from metropolitan-adjacent provincial maiden company at Kembla Grange where he posted superior speed figures (74 and 73). Prepped with two solid Sydney trials at Randwick and Warwick Farm within the last three weeks, neutralizing any first-up concerns. Maps for a perfect stalking trip (canonical style code P) down the spacious 400m home straight.

Major jockey upgrade with leading Hunter rider Aaron Bullock taking the reins. Showed good early toe when leading and boxing on for fifth beaten under three lengths at Newcastle over 1250m second-up. Fitter now and possesses the tactical cruising speed (canonical style code P) ideal for the signature 1280m chute.

First starter by Zousain hailing from the powerful Kris Lees stable. Caught the eye when finishing second in a recent Scone trial on soft going. Despite a wider gate, the long run-up from the 1280m chute allows him ample time to balance up in a stalking position (canonical style code P).

Promising three-year-old filly who made up steady ground on debut at Taree over 1000m on rain-affected going. Secures the coveted inside rail draw and the services of in-form rider Ashley Morgan. Suited by the step up to 1280m where her swooping turn of foot (canonical style code S) can be utilized.

Victorian shipper making his stable debut for Wayne Wilkes. Demonstrated metropolitan-provincial ability in Victoria with a placing at Werribee and a fourth at Kilmore. Prepared for this with a sharp third behind Incremental in a Muswellbrook trial. Has to overcome a wide barrier and 59kg top weight, but fits as a pressing type (canonical style code P).

Live longshot candidate from the shrewd Adam Duggan stable. Found the line reasonably well from off the pace on debut at Port Macquarie over 1200m on soft ground. Gains Luke Rolls in the saddle and has the closing profile (canonical style code S) to exploit contested early fractions down the 400m stretch.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Brings superior provincial credentials into this country Class 1 plate, having finished runner-up in consecutive Newcastle Cl1s with speed ratings of 66 and 70. Handled 59.0kg solidly when running 2nd to dominant winner Bradford over 1600m at Tamworth on heavy/soft going last start. Barrier 3 gives him the economical run in transit tucked just behind the speed in canonical style P. Looks the clear testing material on the Soft 7 surface.

Adam Duggan-trained 6yo gelding who broke through in style last time out over 1600m on a soft deck at Taree, running a 63 speed rating and holding Whoopi Do by 1.5 lengths. Carrying 59.0kg with leading jockey Ashley Morgan retained. Uses presser canonical style P to stalk the early tempo. The sweeping 400m home straight at Skellatar Park suits his grinding stamina, though he concedes a tactical class edge to Tacitly.

Second runner from the sharp Archibald stable, booking Reece Jones. Boasts prior metropolitan winning form at Doomben over 1600m and a 3rd over 1800m on Heavy ground at Sunshine Coast. Carries 57.0kg (receiving 2.0kg from the male rivals). Canonical style P/S gives her the tactical versatility to wind up out wide on the better going. Rates as the principal danger.

Tony Ball-trained mare who gets the premier booking of Aaron Bullock. Followed up a Newcastle Super Maiden win (65 rating) with a solid 2nd behind Purple Haze at Taree over 1600m. Carries 57.0kg from an ideal middle gate. Canonical style S allows her to track the main pack and launch down the center of the spacious 400m Muswellbrook stretch.

Lugs 59.0kg and must negotiate an awkward outside post, but his canonical style C means he drops back anyway to save energy before unleashing late. In the mix for minor exotics.
